text: {"id":"explore","title":"Average CPU per host over time","viz":"line","description":"Computes the average CPU utilization in percent per host, grouped into one-minute time buckets.","format":"percent","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, host, avg(cpu_pct) AS avg_cpu FROM system_metrics GROUP BY minute, host ORDER BY minute","timeField":"minute"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":12,"h":4},"options":{"decimals":1,"unit":"%","legend":"bottom"}}
